ruleContent.content:
<js>
var m = result.match(/qsbs\.bb\('([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)'\)/g);
var out = [];
if (m) {
  for (var i = 0; i < m.length; i++) {
    var d = String(java.base64Decode(m[i].match(/'([^']+)'/)[1]));
    if (d.indexOf('<p') != 0) continue;
    var t = d.replace(/<\/?p[^>]*>/g, '');
    t = t.replace(/[-－]{0,3}>{0,3}\s*少年小说网（www\.snxsw\.com）[^！\n]{0,20}！/g, '');
    t = t.replace(/\s*-{1,3}>*\s*$/, '');
    if (!t) continue;
    if (/^第[0-9零一二两三四五六七八九十百千万]+章.{0,15}$/.test(t) && !/[。！？…”"]$/.test(t)) continue;
    out.push(t);
  }
}
out.join('\n')
</js>
